# Mashamba

> Mashamba (FFP (U) Ltd) is a Ugandan fresh produce airfreight exporter, supplying more than nine export-grade horticultural crops to international buyers with reliable cold-chain handling and full export documentation. Focus: operational precision, logistics credibility, and modern Ugandan export excellence.

Mashamba is the trading name of FFP (U) Ltd, a registered exporter of horticultural products based in Uganda. The company sources, packs, and airfreights fresh produce (hot peppers, ginger, matoke, sweet potatoes, avocados, white African eggplant, cocoyam, sugar cane, and apple bananas) from Entebbe International Airport to international markets including the United Kingdom, the Netherlands, Germany, the UAE, and Saudi Arabia. The company holds 4 President's Export Awards and Icemark-Africa certification. Buyers can review the product range, request a per-product export quote, and read free export guides.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://ffp-mashamba.com/): Overview of Mashamba's fresh produce export operation, markets served, and trust credentials.
- [About](https://ffp-mashamba.com/about): Company story, 25 years in Uganda's export trade, leadership team, and export awards.
- [Products](https://ffp-mashamba.com/products): Full range of more than nine export-grade Ugandan crops with specifications.
- [Get an Export Quote](https://ffp-mashamba.com/get-quotes): Request a per-product export quote (primary enquiry form).
- [Contact Us](https://ffp-mashamba.com/contact-us): Reach the Mashamba export team by form, phone, or WhatsApp.

## Crops

- [Ugandan Hot Peppers](https://ffp-mashamba.com/products/ugandan-hot-peppers): Fresh export-grade hot peppers airfreighted from Uganda, with handling and buyer FAQs.
- [Ugandan Ginger](https://ffp-mashamba.com/products/ugandan-ginger): Fresh mature ginger for international buyers, specifications and export handling.
- [Ugandan Matoke](https://ffp-mashamba.com/products/ugandan-matoke): East African Highland cooking bananas, green-harvested for export.
- [Ugandan Avocados](https://ffp-mashamba.com/products/ugandan-avocados): Fresh Ugandan avocados for importers and wholesalers.
- [Ugandan Sweet Potatoes](https://ffp-mashamba.com/products/ugandan-sweet-potatoes): Export-grade sweet potatoes with storage and shipping guidance.
- [Ugandan White African Eggplant](https://ffp-mashamba.com/products/ugandan-white-african-eggplant): Garden eggs (entula) for ethnic and specialty produce markets.
- [Ugandan Cocoyam](https://ffp-mashamba.com/products/ugandan-cocoyam): Soil-free cocoyam (malanga, tannia) prepared to phytosanitary standards.
- [Ugandan Sugar Cane](https://ffp-mashamba.com/products/ugandan-sugar-cane): Fresh chewing cane cut for consumption, export handling and specifications.
- [Ugandan Apple Bananas](https://ffp-mashamba.com/products/ugandan-apple-bananas): Sweet Sukali Ndizi dessert bananas for international markets.

- [Uganda Fresh Produce to the UK](https://ffp-mashamba.com/markets/uganda-fresh-produce-uk): Market page for UK buyers sourcing Ugandan fresh produce by airfreight.
- [Uganda Fresh Produce to the UAE](https://ffp-mashamba.com/markets/uganda-fresh-produce-uae): Supplying Dubai and Gulf importers with Ugandan fresh produce.
- [Uganda Fresh Produce to Saudi Arabia](https://ffp-mashamba.com/markets/uganda-fresh-produce-saudi-arabia): Market page for Saudi importers, SFDA-compliant sourcing.
- [Uganda Fresh Produce to the Netherlands](https://ffp-mashamba.com/markets/uganda-fresh-produce-netherlands): Supplying Dutch importers and the EU distribution hub.
- [Uganda Fresh Produce to Germany](https://ffp-mashamba.com/markets/uganda-fresh-produce-germany): Market page for German importers and wholesalers.
